title: Text: DET Tom Moore ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Are these figures accurate? $1.8 mill for de la Cruz, $1.45 for Reyes

Good morning Anthony. I’m not going to specifically comment on bonus figures for any players that we sign. Also, we have no deals at this point. Check back with me later today as we hope to have something.
Thanks...have deals been agreed to, like Jesse Sanchez is saying?
There are things we are working on at the moment but have nothing to announce yet.
Alright, so that report is inaccurate?
We have nothing to report at this point.
Alright, thanks. Can I quote you on that?
Not trying to be a pain in the ass but it looks bad when I send in something citing another person on my beat
I completely understand. No problem quoting me on that.
